title: liveSttSessionFinish.v1
description: Gateway -> live-stt finish handshake (#3746 AI-D3/BE-D4, design D4). Sent once when the gateway closes a session; carries the identity envelope for the post-session diarization batch and the expected sample total for the whole-session integrity check (mismatch => cancel, no attribution). Contains no audio and no transcript text. The session key is the same opaque value the gateway sent on each /transcribe window POST (X-Stt-Session-Key).

expectedSampleCount.description: PCM16 mono 16 kHz samples the gateway forwarded for this session; live-stt cancels the batch when its store holds a different total.
